name: I need my kitchen cabinets removed soon—what should I do first?

mainEntity.name: I need my kitchen cabinets removed soon—what should I do first?

acceptedAnswer.text: Start by deciding whether you want a full cabinet tear-out or careful deconstruction for reuse. For homes in Denver, Centennial, Greenwood Village, Foxfield, and Parker, the right first step is a site check so the crew can confirm cabinet condition, access, and whether countertops, plumbing, or appliances need to be disconnected first.
acceptedAnswer.description: Decide whether you want a full removal or a careful deconstruction for reuse, then schedule a site check. The crew can confirm access, cabinet condition, and whether utilities or appliances need to be disconnected first.
